statement_summary: Maintain a documented security program
Owner designated security lead in writing
Annual risk assessment using SP 800-30
Risk decision rules; High never accepted as is; crop risks treated before freeze season
Annual self-assessment with an outside review every second year
Annual policy review
Written, time-limited exceptions
Family members use their own standard laptop account
Check terms and MFA before connecting a new SaaS, device, or AI tool
Vendor list with third-party agents and registered breach contacts
Dealer viewer role except in owner-opened service windows; contract terms at renewal
Annual review of the FMIS vendor SOC 2 report and customer controls
Remove supplier access the day a relationship ends
AI tools only after a P10 assessment; no vendor training on farm data without opt-in; no AI control of irrigation
Own accounts; no shared credentials
Authenticator-app MFA on SYS-01, booking, email, accounting, and banking
Unique 14-character passphrases in a password manager; none saved in a shared browser
No default passwords on any device
SYS-01 account review each July and November
Sealed recovery codes held by the owner's attorney
Monthly activity log review, weekly in freeze season
Change log for irrigation, fertigation, and alarm settings
Device lock after 5 minutes (phone and tablet 1 minute)
Three-level data classification
Restricted data only in approved systems; delete W-9 scans
Encryption on every device
Monthly farm-held exports, versioned storage, encrypted backup drive, quarterly restore test
Written annual qualified exemption review; farm name and complete address at every point of purchase and web page
Retention (exemption records at least 4 years) and disposal of customer records and devices
Updates, antivirus, official software sources, USB sticks scanned
Isolated customer Wi-Fi; separate pump house network; firmware kept current
Call-back before changing any payee's bank details
Annual security course for the owner; family briefing
Incident runbook with printed contacts
Same-day incident log with discovery time
Crop first: switch irrigation to local and run it by hand
Meet Florida notice deadlines in the P08 matrix
No ransom without counsel and an OFAC check
Freeze-night procedure posted and rehearsed each November
Standalone freeze alarm calling the owner and the neighbor
Written mutual-aid arrangement with a neighboring grower
